metadata.title: Skip Tracing for Curative Title: Find Owners Others Can't
metadata.author: Logan Fullmer
metadata.shortDescription:
Skip tracing makes or breaks curative title deals. If you can't find the owners, you can't close. Matt Hecker, co-founder of SmartSkip.io, runs a skip tracing platform and his own real estate investing business, so he sees both sides: the data and the dials.

In this episode of Dirty Deeds, Matt and Logan Fullmer break down how accurate skip tracing data really is, why you should track which phone numbers actually connect, and how SmartSkip layers multiple data providers to get better results. They also cover how to use relatives and associates to track down missing owners, the difference between regulated and unregulated data, and when to bulk dial vs. work a file by hand.

Plus, the cold caller's nightmare: a man who made about $65,000 a year as a side job suing investors who called him, and why knowing when to walk away from a 21-owner deal matters as much as knowing how to find them.

You'll learn:
- How accurate skip tracing data really is
- Why you should tag and track your phone numbers in your CRM
- How layering multiple data sources improves your hit rate
- How to use relatives and associates to find missing owners
- Regulated vs. unregulated data, and when you need each
- When to bulk dial and when to work leads one at a time
- How many owners is too many on a curative title deal
